verdict.rationale: e-FRRO is a government e-services portal, which could plausibly ship a built-in assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only covers front-door HTTP probes (a script-only shell at the root and a 404 on the legacy entry path). Neither says anything about an AI assistant or task delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
